title: Game completion can be front-run by stakers
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** High  **Likelihood:** Low  ## Description  Stakers in the protocol profit from players losing their bets and incur losses when players win.  Users can front-run the completion of a lost game by staking tokens, achieving an unrealized profit. While the staker will have to wait for the cooldown period to unstake, and in that period, the unrealized profits can be lost, the repetition of this process in the long term is statistically profitable.
